name: JW Marriott Hotel Rio de Janeiro
insider_take: This sophisticated beachfront sanctuary sits perfectly positioned on Copacabana Beach, where Rio's legendary energy meets refined luxury in one of the world's most iconic coastal settings.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Rio is the only luxury hotel directly on famous Copacabana Beach, featuring panoramic Atlantic Ocean views from most rooms. The property boasts the city's highest rooftop pool and bar, offering 360-degree views of Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain, and the sparkling coastline. Its prime location places you steps from the legendary beach where bossa nova was born.
pro_tip: Visit the rooftop bar at sunset for the most spectacular views in Rio – you'll see both Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain illuminated while sipping caipirinhas 23 floors above Copacabana.
dont_miss: Take a morning jog along the iconic 2.5-mile Copacabana promenade right outside your door, then explore the vibrant Ipanema neighborhood just 10 minutes away. The hotel's concierge can arrange exclusive access to the famous Carnival rehearsals during season, and the nearby Forte de Copacabana offers fascinating military history with stunning coastal views.
pros: Prime Copacabana beachfront location with stunning ocean views
Luxury JW Marriott amenities including rooftop pool and spa
Elegant rooms and suites with modern Brazilian design
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
cons: High-end hotel may feel formal for casual travelers
